Chapter 1061: 12 A Promise (Request For Monthly Tickets)

Chapter 1061: Chapter 12 A Promise (Request for Monthly Tickets)

The Eye of Myriad Laws scrutinized Lin Yuan repeatedly.

At present, merely within the Path Splitting Realm’s evolutionary pathway, to pioneer a branch capable of reaching the Chaos Realm’s potential was already extraordinary.

Under such premises, the Eye of Myriad Laws determined that Lin Yuan’s potential was significant, with the hope of stepping into the perfection of the Chaos Realm.

Otherwise, it wouldn’t have laid out such conditions.

The precondition for Lin Yuan working for the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was for him to achieve perfection in the Chaos Realm.

If Lin Yuan failed to reach perfection in the Chaos Realm, the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion would certainly suffer loss.

…

“How many branch paths have you opened up?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws observed Lin Yuan again, feeling that he wasn’t lying.

“For the Path Splitting Realm’s evolutionary pathway, to have developed more than one branch is remarkable. Even if the potential of those other branches isn’t high enough to reach the Sovereign Realm, this nonetheless demonstrates the breadth of the primary evolutionary path.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws felt pleasantly surprised. “Could it be that I’ve truly found a treasure this time? A Path Splitting Realm with such terrifying potential hasn’t been seen in many Cosmic Eras.”

The Chaos Realm’s perfection varied significantly, distinguishing between ordinary Chaos Great Saints and peerless Great Saints.

If Lin Yuan’s primary evolutionary pathway allowed for the pioneering of multiple branches while still at the Path Splitting Realm level, it indicated a strong likelihood of him becoming a peerless Great Saint.

A peerless Great Saint, even amidst the vast Chaos Void, was exceedingly rare. For the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion to command such an existence would be exceptionally challenging.

“There are some.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Thus far, his main evolutionary pathway—centered on the Martial Arts Evolution Road—had pioneered a total of 361 branch paths.

Among them, 99 branch pathways had been fully refined, thus enabling their dissemination within human civilization.

As for the remaining 200 to 300 branch pathways, although largely developed, they had not been completely refined. However, they were still viable for practice without significant issues.

“They’re all here.”

With a turn of his hand, Lin Yuan made over 300 jade slips appear before him.

Out of the 361 branch pathways, apart from nine reserved for the nine supreme powerhouses of human civilization, the rest were all presented by Lin Yuan.

“So many?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws was somewhat taken aback. The Life and Death Martial Dao’s evolutionary pathway had required only one jade slip for its entire record, yet the other branch paths Lin Yuan developed required several hundred jade slips?

The old man with the wine gourd beside them also grew curious.

He had been quietly listening to the conversation between the Eye of Myriad Laws and Lin Yuan.

As a branch Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, the old man with the wine gourd was one of their own, entirely trustworthy, so the Eye of Myriad Laws hadn’t concealed anything from him.

From their exchange, the old man discerned how highly the Eye of Myriad Laws regarded Lin Yuan. The many conditions on that golden scroll required Lin Yuan first to attain perfection in the Chaos Realm.

Chaos Realm perfection?

That was the domain of the Chaos Great Saints.

Since the Eye of Myriad Laws dared to make such assertions, it clearly believed Lin Yuan capable of achieving perfection in the Chaos Realm.

The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion’s transcendent status up to this day wasn’t just because of the unfathomable existence of the Eye of Myriad Laws, but also due to certain limiting relationships the pavilion maintained with a few Chaos Great Saints in the Chaos Void.

Thus, seeing the Eye of Myriad Laws strike a “deal” with Lin Yuan, the old man felt secretly pleased.

At least in the distant future, the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion would gain the support of another Great Saint.

But when Lin Yuan turned his hand to produce so many jade slips, the old man’s doubts were not any fewer than those of the Eye of Myriad Laws.

Could it be that the other evolutionary pathways Lin Yuan had pioneered were exceedingly intricate and detailed? Was that why so many jade slips were required for records?

But that didn’t make sense—each jade slip had an exceedingly high capacity for information storage. What kind of evolutionary pathways would necessitate hundreds of jade slips together?

“Take a look.”

After presenting the jade slips, Lin Yuan looked expectantly at the Eye of Myriad Laws.

These were merely the branch paths he had managed to pioneer temporarily. Given more time, he could open up even more evolutionary pathways.

The Martial Arts Evolution Road encompassed all Dao, and theoretically, there was no limit to the number of evolutionary pathways that could be pioneered.

But this was only in theory. At least while Lin Yuan remained in the Path Splitting Realm, he could at most develop just over a thousand branch pathways. Upon reaching the Sovereign Realm, the number would increase significantly, and upon entering the Chaos Realm, there would likely be a dramatic surge.

These numerous evolutionary pathways were to be disseminated by the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion. Lin Yuan felt that even if he were to concede a little, the loss would still be negligible.

Were he to handle such dissemination on his own, the effort required would be unimaginable.

To confine them to internal digestion within human civilization? That was unrealistic as well—the sheer population base of human civilization couldn’t possibly produce so many twelfth-layer practitioners.

“Take a look, you say?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws hesitated slightly, glancing at Lin Yuan, then at the over 300 jade slips before it. For a moment, it was uncertain.

Should… should *I* take a look?

After a brief pause, the Eye of Myriad Laws began perusing the first jade slip.

This jade slip documented an evolutionary pathway named Illusory Realm Martial Dao, a Martial Dao refined using the path of illusions as its foundation.

The Illusory Realm Martial Dao was not particularly adept in direct assault but focused primarily on constructing illusionary worlds to exert influence and suppression.

Whirr—

Within the Eye of Myriad Laws’ pupils, pathways entirely composed of illusory realms began to extend and twist, ultimately halting just before touching the boundless layers of chaos.

“The potential of this evolutionary pathway is at its peak within the Sovereign Realm.”

This was the conclusion of the Eye of Myriad Laws, yet there was no trace of relaxation in its expression.

Thus far, the Illusory Realm Martial Dao it had examined had been fully documented within a single jade slip.

A single jade slip for one evolutionary pathway?

Then what about the hundreds of jade slips before it?
